title: TRUST DoD Attestation — Security Agent
description: Self-attestation block the security agent MUST fill at the end of every execution. Written to <run-dir>/agents/security.dod.json. See references/DOD.md for field-by-field rules.

agent_version.description: SemVer of the skill. From SKILL.md frontmatter metadata.agent_version.

run_id.description: UUID assigned by the orchestrator for this run. From run-manifest.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the attestation was written.

loaded.description: true if ALL required grounding docs were successfully loaded.

docs_read.description: One entry per loaded grounding doc.

path.description: Relative path within the grounding source (e.g. '06-security-policy.md').

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file content. Computed via hashlib.sha256.

sections_indexed.description: Number of Markdown headings parsed as section anchors.

missing_required.description: Paths of required docs that failed to load. MUST be empty to pass DoD.

loaded.description: true if security.checklist.md was parsed without errors.

rules_in_checklist_total.description: Count of distinct rule_id declarations in the checklist.

rules_with_valid_source.description: Count of rules whose source resolves to an existing grounding section. Must equal rules_in_checklist_total.

diff_files_total.description: Total files in the PR diff (all agents).

files_in_domain_total.description: Files in diff that match this agent's file_patterns.

files_in_domain_evaluated.description: Files actually evaluated. MUST equal files_in_domain_total.

files_in_domain_evaluated_pct.description: Percentage evaluated. MUST be 100 to pass DoD.

rules_evaluated_total.description: Rules that appear in coverage matrix. Must equal rules_in_checklist_total.

rules_evaluated_pct.description: Percentage of rules covered. MUST be 100 to pass DoD.

coverage_matrix_complete.description: true only if every (rule x file) pair has a verdict.

not_applicable_with_justification_pct.description: % of N/A verdicts that include a non-empty reason. MUST be 100.

emitted.description: Number of findings written to security.findings.json.

every_finding_has_rule_id.description: true if all emitted findings have a non-null rule_id.

every_finding_has_rule_source.description: true if all emitted findings have a non-null rule_source.

every_finding_has_evidence_quote.description: true if all emitted findings have a non-empty evidence_quote.

every_finding_has_confidence.description: true if all emitted findings have a numeric confidence field.

every_finding_confidence_gte_080.description: true if every confidence value is >= 0.80.

every_evidence_quote_literal.description: true if every evidence_quote appears verbatim (character-by-character) in the diff. Verified by check_evidence_literal.py.

self_check_passed.description: true only if halt_required is false. The orchestrator reads this field first.

halt_required.description: true if any DoD criterion failed. Triggers orchestrator HALT.
